title: top-up: bounded subscription comparison and disposable execution
definition: Reviewed the comparison orchestrator, subscription-only text provider and disposable runner. Generated source is data until a verified container lease is established. Runtime and image inspection, argv execution, environment allowlisting, capability dropping, read-only mounts, bounded time/output and exact-name cleanup are explicit. Positive subscription authentication is required; provider tools, hooks and MCP are disabled. Authoritative acceptance runs in a parent process and treats child output as a protocol, not a test verdict. Unknown execution and telemetry are preserved.
